name: Mephenytoin
summary: Mephenytoin (marketed as Mesantoin by Novartis) is a hydantoin, used as an anticonvulsant. It was introduced approximately 10 years after phenytoin, in the late 1940s. The significant metabolite of mephenytoin is nirvanol (5-ethyl-5-phenylhydantoin), which was the first hydantoin (briefly used as a hypnotic).

uses.text: Mephenytoin (marketed as Mesantoin by Novartis) is a hydantoin, used as an anticonvulsant. The significant metabolite of mephenytoin is nirvanol (5-ethyl-5-phenylhydantoin), which was the first hydantoin (briefly used as a hypnotic). It is still studied largely because of its interesting hydroxylation polymorphism.

pharmacology.en: Like phenytoin, it is thought to work mainly by blocking sodium channels in nerve cells, which stops them firing rapidly over and over and helps prevent seizures from spreading.
pharmacology.zh: 和苯妥英一樣，它被認為主要是阻斷神經細胞的鈉離子通道，使神經無法快速反覆放電，進而防止癲癇擴散。
pharmacology.zhHans: 和苯妥英一样，它被认为主要是阻断神经细胞的钠离子信道，使神经无法快速反复放电，进而防止癫痫扩散。

sideEffects.en: It can cause drowsiness, dizziness, poor coordination and rash. It fell out of use largely because it can cause serious blood disorders, such as a dangerous fall in white blood cells, and severe skin reactions.
sideEffects.zh: 它可能引起嗜睡、頭暈、協調變差與皮疹。它之所以不再使用，主要是因為可能造成嚴重的血液疾病，例如白血球危險地減少，以及嚴重的皮膚反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它可能引起嗜睡、头晕、协调制差与皮疹。它之所以不再使用，主要是因为可能造成严重的血液疾病，例如白血球危险地减少，以及严重的皮肤反应。

fact.en: Mephenytoin gave its name to a well-known genetic trait: some people break it down very slowly because of differences in the liver enzyme CYP2C19, first discovered through studies of this drug.
fact.zh: 美芬妥英讓一種著名的遺傳特質因它而得名：有些人因肝臟酵素 CYP2C19 的差異而代謝它非常緩慢，這是透過研究這種藥物而首次發現的。
fact.zhHans: 美芬妥英让一种著名的遗传特质因它而得名：有些人因肝脏酵素 CYP2C19 的差异而代谢它非常缓慢，这是通过研究这种药物而首次发现的。
